title: WakeCI configuration
description: config.json of the WakeCI controller. `wakeci check` applies these rules and a few more (unique machine names, distinct files, a valid host, the metrics port range, and whole numbers: JSON Schema treats 1.0 as an integer, wakeci check does not).

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

dry_run.description: Log decisions without sending packets or SSH commands.

idle_minutes.description: Idle time of all runners of a machine before it is suspended.

broadcast.description: IPv4 broadcast address for Wake-on-LAN packets.

metrics_listen.description: <address>:<port> of the /metrics endpoint; the port is 1-65535 (checked by wakeci check).

state_file.description: When each machine was last online (the 14-day rule); written a few times a day.

known_hosts.description: Host keys of the machines, checked strictly; the installer adds the awake ones.

url_file.description: File holding the webhook URL (a secret).

format.description: discord, slack or json: the shape of the posted message.

after_minutes.description: How long a problem must last before it is reported.

repeat_hours.description: How often a message repeats while the problem lasts.

sources.description: Where runners are registered, and the repositories whose jobs they take.

runners_path.description: Where the runners are registered: repos/<owner>/<repo> or orgs/<org>.

repos.description: The repositories whose queued jobs these runners take.

token_file.description: File holding this source's read-only token.

machines.description: The machines that are woken and suspended.

mac.description: MAC address of the interface Wake-on-LAN reaches.

host.description: Address or host name; FILL-IN, which wakeci discover writes, is refused.

runner_prefixes.description: Every runner whose name starts with one of these belongs to this machine.
